about_the_game:
Chronos Trials RPG is a loot-driven, incremental roguelite where time itself is your greatest enemy. You play as the unskilled warrior and son of Chronos, the God of Time. Disappointed by your weakness, he traps you in an endless time loop—promising freedom only if you can defeat him in combat.

Battle hundreds of enemies and uncover a vast arsenal of weapons, armour, and equipment. With only a limited number of hours each day, you must travel as far as possible before the loop resets, returning you home. The more enemies you defeat, the greater the rewards you’ll find—legendary gear, secret areas, and, ultimately, a chance to confront your father.

FIND YOUR PLAYSTYLE

Featuring an autobattle combat system, Chronos Trials RPG offers countless build options. Reflect damage back at your foes, unleash flurries of strikes each turn, or harness powerful spells and abilities in mid-battle. The choice is yours—no two fights need to play the same.

UPGRADE YOUR HERO

Beyond the hundreds of items you can collect, you’ll grow stronger through the Skill Tree, unlocking new abilities and amplifying the strengths of your chosen build. Progression isn't determined entirely by RNG and lucky drops from bosses - the game provides constant opportunities to push you forward.

EACH DAY IS UNIQUE

The Relic System grants you new buffs each day, encouraging experimentation with different strategies. Whether you’re stuck or simply want to try something new, relics provide the edge you need to push further.

CHOICES MATTER

Your journey isn’t only about combat. Along the way, you’ll encounter NPCs you can choose to help—or betray—in exchange for services, shortcuts, or power. Every choice you make shapes the world and influences the game’s progression, ensuring no two playthroughs are the same.

AN EXPANSIVE SOUNDTRACK

Every area features its own unique music, creating a diverse and immersive soundtrack that enhances your adventure. Tracks seamlessly carry into combat, letting you enjoy the atmosphere without interruption.

name: Chronos Trials RPG

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU (Intel Core 2 Duo or equivalent)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9 / OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 750 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU (Intel i3/i5 or AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 compatible GPU (or better)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
